# FindSkill.ai

> > FindSkill.ai provides 1200+ free AI skill templates, 233 certified courses, and prompt engineering tools for mastering AI across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other platforms.

FindSkill.ai is a comprehensive platform for learning AI skills through ready-to-use templates, structured courses, and hands-on tools. It caters to professionals seeking to master prompt engineering, productivity automation, and AI fundamentals across multiple AI platforms.

## Key Topics

- Prompt Engineering
- AI Skill Templates
- ChatGPT
- Claude
- Gemini

- System Prompts

- Productivity Skills

- Copilot
- Context Windows
- Best Practices
- AI Fundamentals

## Core Learning Resources

- [AI Skill Templates](https://findskill.ai/skills): Main skill templates library with 1200+ ready-to-use prompts for business & productivity
- [Free AI Courses with Certificate](https://findskill.ai/courses): 233 free AI courses with certificates across 40+ professions, 1-2 hours each
- [Free AI Fundamentals Course](https://findskill.ai/courses/ai-fundamentals): Free beginner AI fundamentals course with 8 lessons and certificate
- [New Arrivals](https://findskill.ai/new-arrivals): Latest AI skills, system prompts, and templates added to the collection

## AI Platform Guides

- [ChatGPT Guide](https://findskill.ai/platforms/chatgpt): ChatGPT platform guide with skills, features, and best practices
- [Claude Guide](https://findskill.ai/platforms/claude): Claude platform guide covering coding, long-context analysis & agentic workflows
- [Gemini Guide](https://findskill.ai/platforms/gemini): Google Gemini platform guide with multimodal tasks and Workspace integration
- [Copilot Guide](https://findskill.ai/platforms/copilot): GitHub Copilot & Microsoft 365 Copilot guide for code generation & productivity
- [Mistral Guide](https://findskill.ai/platforms/mistral): Mistral AI platform guide for European models, coding & multilingual tasks

## AI Tools & Utilities

- [AI Prompt Generator Tool](https://findskill.ai/blog/ai-prompt-generator): Free AI prompt generator tool for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & other assistants
- [System Prompt Generator](https://findskill.ai/blog/system-prompt-generator): Build custom AI system prompts from templates for ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini
- [AI Token Counter](https://findskill.ai/blog/ai-token-counter): Free token counter and cost calculator for multiple AI platforms
- [AI Text Humanizer](https://findskill.ai/blog/ai-text-humanizer): Free tool to humanize AI-generated text from ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini
- [Meta Description Generator](https://findskill.ai/blog/meta-description-generator): Free SEO meta description generator for optimized 150-160 character descriptions

## Blog & Learning Hub

- [AI Blog](https://findskill.ai/blog): Blog covering prompt engineering, AI tool reviews, and productivity tips

## Account & Subscription

- [Pricing Plans](https://findskill.ai/pricing): Pricing plans for FindSkill.ai Pro with unlimited saves and ad-free access
